notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.3.16
notes.notes:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent final altar from updating end game stage
[*] Fixed an issue that would block certain achievements from updating
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause UI from getting stuck during stealing skulls
[*] Fixed collision issue inside "Warehouse" that would allow players to climb on windows
[/list]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased [i]lens flare[/i] and [i]bloom[/i] intensity
[*] Adjusted volume levels for; [i]footsteps, cold state and freezing state[/i]
[*] Adjusted difficulty level; The "Cryptid" is now [b]much more aggressive[/b] and may rush towards players depending on stress stage
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.2.27
notes.notes:

[*] Fixed an issue with "M" button on keyboard and Keypad buttons that caused in game menu to be stuck
[/list]
